newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Bhutto gives up finance post.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Bhutto gives up finance post.

text.p: Pakistani Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto gave up the finance portfolio she has held for three years and named her privatisation chief to the post on Monday, a government official said.
He said Privatisation Minister Syed Naveed Qamar had been appointed as Minister for Finance and Economic Affairs and would keep his old portfolio. No official announcement has been made.

Bhutto had been her own finance minister since taking power in October 1993, appointing Makhdoom Shahabuddin as State Minister for Finance. However, the ministry was actually run by Bhutto's adviser for finance and economic affairs V.A. Jafarey.
It was not immediately clear whether Shahabuddin had kept his job in what the official said was a drastic shake-up.
Government sources said Jafarey had lost his post, but it was unclear if he had resigned or been sacked.

The official said Moeen Afzal, additional secretary at the finance ministry, had been promoted to secretary in place of Mian Tayyeb, known to be close to Jafarey. Tayyeb was transferred to the Ministry of Industries and Production.
